sourceChecks.locator: Issue listing; “Geometric indicators of local plasticity in glasses measured by scanning small-beam diffraction,” pp. 4–17

sourceChecks.title: Beam damage in operando X-ray diffraction studies of Li-ion batteries

innovations.summary: An actually opened crystallogenesis review describes protein crystallization as a continuing challenge and protein-specific preparation. It documents a research goal, not a universal additive or first/second-attempt method. The prior glass-issue citation was unrelated and removed from this item.

claims.claim: A universal reproducible additive or surface crystallizes any soluble or membrane protein, including intrinsically disordered regions, on the first or second attempt.
claims.scope: An IUCr review describes partial coverage of macromolecular diversity, with membrane proteins and unfolded/disordered domains posing particular problems.
claims.limitations: No opened source establishes universal first/second-attempt success or a universal additive.

claims.claim: This would yield structures for the remaining ~70% of the proteome and all “undruggable” targets.
claims.scope: No inspected source substantiated the numerical proteome coverage or universal druggability outcome.
claims.limitations: Impact forecast is not supported by the crystallogenesis review.
